key_patterns: Styling uses literal Tailwind utility classes (e.g. bg-slate-900, text-blue-400, border-slate-800) on elements, NOT the :root CSS custom properties (those are mostly unused by components today). So retheming is mainly per-file find/replace of literal utility classes to the light palette; the :root tokens + a new @theme block are the shared source of truth and are read by var(--...) consumers (body, leaflet CSS). cn() helper from @/lib/utils merges classes. UI primitives use class-variance-authority (cva). Map markers in camera-map.tsx are built as inline-styled HTML strings inside L.divIcon with HARDCODED hex colors — edit those template literals directly. Status->color mapping: online/green, maintenance/amber, offline/red; traffic current_light: green/amber/red.
typography: Keep Lexend (sans body/UI, already imported, variable --font-lexend-sans) and Geist Mono (IDs/coords, --font-geist-mono). ADD Fraunces via next/font/google (variable --font-fraunces) for brand/title + large display headings ONLY. Wire all three into Tailwind by adding a @theme block to globals.css: --font-sans: var(--font-lexend-sans); --font-mono: var(--font-geist-mono); --font-serif: var(--font-fraunces). Without this @theme block the font-sans/serif/mono utilities fall back to apple-system — this is the current (broken) state and must be fixed in FEAT-001.
